query: 2020, textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE p.year = 2020
  AND (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
      plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%textattack%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: 2016, emnlp, nanjing normal university, amr parsing with an incremental joint model
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON pa.author_id = ai.author_id
JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2016
  AND LOWER(p.canonical_venue) = 'emnlp'
  AND LOWER(i.display_name) LIKE '%nanjing normal university%'
  AND (
    LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%amr%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%abstract meaning representation%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%incremental joint model%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%amr%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%abstract meaning representation%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%incremental joint model%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%amr parsing with an incremental joint model%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%amr%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%incremental joint model%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%amr parsing with an incremental joint model%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: rtm at semeval 2016 task 1 predicting semantic similarity with referential translation machines and related statistics, semeval, 2016, koc university
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2016
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%rtm%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rtm%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic similarity%')
  )
  AND (
    p.venue ILIKE '%semeval%' OR
    p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%semeval%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%'
  )
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%koc university%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.venue ILIKE '%semeval%' OR p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%semeval%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.year = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: a hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis, emnlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  p.canonical_venue ILIKE 'EMNLP'
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%review%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%review%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
